body:
## Code Review

This pull request integrates full 9709 beta posture rows into the Copilot visible wording path, adding comprehensive test coverage, a detailed readback document, and visual display gating logic. The review feedback highlights two important issues: first, a logical bug in `copilot-evidence-wording-gate.js` where `student_display_blocked` is directly tied to `visualDiagnosisBlocked`, which incorrectly bypasses general eligibility checks for text-only questions; second, an ordering issue in `v1-student-adapter.js` where spreading `postureContext` after `source` silently overwrites explicit context packet overrides.
